# TSMC Management Outlook and Annual Results Investigation

**Insufficient evidence**

No annual USD financial figures were available under supported XBRL tags for TSM due to tool coverage limits for foreign issuer reporting [Ef75d1e1553].

## What was knowable then

As of the specified date bounds, no annual USD financial figures were available under supported XBRL tags for TSM revenue [Ef75d1e1553], net income [Ec4e4c88199], operating income [E89fe5ed982], operating cash flow [E90b76378d6], or capex [E4e2248e994]. Furthermore, no matching records could be found in the date-bounded source [E51cce6276c].

## What happened later

Subsequent data retrieval through March 2025 similarly yielded no annual USD financial observations under supported XBRL tags for TSM revenue [E1a363f4326], net income [E5ef377a598], operating income [E40531086dd], operating cash flow [Ef1cbe59cd6], or capex [Ed99b47d021]. Vendor-adjusted price data and macroeconomic series provide broader hindsight context but cannot substitute for issuer-reported financial metrics [E70ea691411](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/FEDFUNDS) [Ecdcd46e32b](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CPIAUCSL) [Eb619673371](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/TSM/history/).

## The peer test

Only TSM was selected. Add a peer company to compare results.

## Cross-examination

Because no management claims or verifiable quantitative outlook passages were retrieved for TSM, no forecasts or management promises can be tested against financial outcomes [E51cce6276c]. The lack of records prevents any evaluation of management intent or operational causation.

## Limits

- No supported XBRL tags or annual USD financial figures available for TSM due to foreign issuer reporting or IFRS format limits.
- No matching records found in the date-bounded source for Tsm claims.
